data.name: Depu
data.gender_notes: Depu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Depu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dhana', which means wealth or fortune. The suffix 'pu' means gift from the Lord. Thus, Depu signifies a divine gift bestowed by the Lord. The name Depu carries the meaning “Lord's Gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Depu usually hope their child will grow to embody lord's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Depu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord's Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Depu total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
